title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Class Record. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Class Record
options.lineage: the green-bound class record book teachers keep attendance in
options.thesis: Every event is a page in the school's class record; check-in writes the mark in the row.
options.viewport: A ruled sheet headed like a class record (organization, event, date, venue) with numbered student rows; the attendance column fills with ✓, L and A as officers scan.
options.risk: Reads as bureaucratic if the marks and the check-in moment are set timidly.

raised.raise: Absence is drawn: capacity renders as fixed ruled slots, empty ones visible as ghost rows, and pending cells keep their blank ruled box.
Palette capped at five inks with no tints-of-everything; selection and pressed states invert (paper on green) instead of adding new colors.
One fixed header grid rules every event everywhere: organization, title, date slot, venue, seats; cards, sheets and tickets all read it the same way.
One state vocabulary everywhere: ✓ present in ink blue, L late and A absent in red pen, blank is pending, struck-through is cancelled.

options.label: School ID & Lanyard Pass
options.lineage: the laminated school ID and event lanyard pass
options.thesis: Every registration is a pass you wear; the app is a rack of IDs.
options.viewport: The student's next pass front and center as a badge with the QR where the barcode strip sits; events as a stack of passes.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of an events app; strong on tickets but thin on officer and admin tables.

options.label: Copy-Shop Org Flyer
options.lineage: photocopied org flyers on colored copy stock
options.thesis: Each organization owns a paper stock; events are typed sheets pinned by color.
options.viewport: A goldenrod sheet for the org, one typed column of event detail under a copier-enlarged title.
options.case: Students know org flyers by heart (holds audience); loses on clarity for dense attendance tables.
options.risk: Typed single column fights the officer's check-in list and reports.

options.label: Seven-Segment Scoreboard
options.thesis: Check-in as a live door counter.
options.viewport: A giant lit count of who has entered.
options.case: Loses both axes: fun at the door, useless for browsing or reports.
options.kept: Designed absence: empty slots and pending cells are drawn, not omitted.

options.label: Four-Shade Handheld
options.thesis: The school events app as a pixel handheld.
options.viewport: A framed pixel screen with bordered menus.
options.case: Loses both axes: one pixel size cannot carry names and tables.
options.kept: A hard palette cap and inversion as the only selection state.

options.label: Archive Box Wall
options.thesis: Events as a wall of labeled boxes.
options.viewport: A wall of end labels, one per event.
options.case: Loses both axes: no campus resonance.
options.kept: One rigid label grid ruling every item.

options.label: One-Bit Desktop
options.case: Loses both axes: window chrome fights phones at the door.
options.kept: One consistent state vocabulary across every control.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.case: Loses both axes: metaphor with no audience.
options.kept: Every value labelled where it sits.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean admin dashboard: sidebar, stat cards, tables, one brand accent.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar navigation, KPI cards across the top, a data table below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other school system by design.
